existing_tips: S-passive is more common than bli-passive for habitual/general statements.
Both "sjön" and "solen" are simple definite – no double definite needed.
"Ska" + infinitive expresses plans/intentions. The most common future form.
"Vi skulle vilja" is the most formal way to make a request.
"Dit" = to where. "Platsen dit" = the place to which.
